question: Which public digital footprints could distinguish actual transaction activity from strategic fit?
method: Bounded six-query discovery plus existing20-F review; source ideas ranked by specificity, alternative explanations and likely timing. No personal travel reconstruction or private-system access.

verified_observations.observation: PHVS20-F records Annick Deschoolmeester joinedSeptember2021 after Takeda rolesJanuary2019-September2021.
verified_observations.interpretation: Historical network link, not current negotiations or new signal.

verified_observations.observation: September2024 license amendment search excerpt explicitly ties BRAIN royalty assignment to Royalty Pharma monetization.
verified_observations.interpretation: Named financing explanation; not evidence of pharmaceutical buyer deal preparation. Full amendment was not reviewed this turn.

verified_observations.observation: CSL July27,2026 release says Andembry approved in over40countries and pediatric development progressing.
verified_observations.interpretation: Candidate strategic-fit screen, not buyer intent; existing franchise investment is competing explanation.

priority_leads.source: Public merger-background histories from adjacent completed or failed transactions
priority_leads.test: Find identified unsuccessful bidders and explicit unmet acquisition goals; do not identify anonymized parties from suggestive clues.

priority_leads.source: Dated material license amendments and public patent/trademark assignment records
priority_leads.test: Counterparty-specific assignment consent, acquisition option, rights consolidation or lien release; compare routine financing/IP housekeeping.

priority_leads.source: Public job postings and archived corporate career pages on target and candidate buyer
priority_leads.test: Synchronized HAE commercial role changes, integration-oriented roles or target discontinuation of planned hiring; generic business-development roles and deleted ads insufficient.

priority_leads.source: Corporate registries and disclosed subsidiary/guarantee changes
priority_leads.test: Named corporate ownership or capital changes tied to relevant entities; do not treat generic merger-shell formation as target-specific.

priority_leads.source: Clinical registries, public regulatory records and trademark correspondence
priority_leads.test: Named buyer assumes sponsor/applicant responsibilities; contractor updates are competing explanation and ownership transfers usually late.

priority_leads.source: Public corporate domains, certificates and website legal notices
priority_leads.test: Substantive named ownership/content link; registrar,hosting,agency reuse and defensive domains are weak and easily misleading.

decision: No new evidence justifying higher takeover probability. Lead inventory does not assert any footprint exists. Prefer rights-chain audit and named-bidder history over web-infrastructure noise.
limits: No systematic archive/job/registry scrape performed. Strategic-fit candidates are not rumored bidders. No numeric signal weights or probabilities calibrated.
